data.narrative:
Cohesive Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by David Pietrocola that has raised $5M+. The broader Robotics & Manufacturing sector includes 1 public comparable (277810.KQ) and 8 private peers, among them Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, and Locus Robotics. However, the peer set lacks sufficient concentration at the same stage and valuation tier to support reliable median-based triangulation.

Stage-progression methodology is the applicable valuation anchor. Using the $5M total raised as a proxy base value and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $12M. This reflects the expected value creation between funding rounds in early-stage venture capital, absent stage-specific peer multiples.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $11M (low) to $14M (high), centered on $12M. This range reflects a single methodological leg and carries material uncertainty around both the appropriateness of the 2.5x multiplier for this specific team and market segment, and the absence of direct peer comparables to validate cross-sector assumptions. A fuller assessment would require either: (1) narrowing Robotics & Manufacturing peers to a tighter stage and sub-sector cohort, or (2) direct revenue or unit-economics data for Cohesive Robotics to anchor an income-based approach.
